releases.name: v0.3.0 - three cooperating skills, a clean reading copy, three hard gates
releases.notes:
v0.3.0 — three cooperating skills, a clean reading copy, three hard gates

This release turns the single research skill into a small family: the core deep
research skill plus two optional capability skills it hands work off to, with a
cleaner deliverable and a stricter delivery gate. It is the full diff from
v0.2.0.

## Three cooperating skills

- **`meld-deepresearch`** — the core research / evidence / citation loop. Still
 Python-standard-library only.
- **`meld-da`** — an Excel / spreadsheet data-analysis workflow (reading,
 cleaning, filtering, aggregation, statistics, charts, export), adapted from
 SenseNova-Skills' `sn-da-excel-workflow` (MIT) and reworked for portable use.
 Its Python packages are optional; without them it degrades to the built-in
 zero-dependency reader.
- **`meld-search-academic`** — academic search, paper full-text and section
 reading, and citation-tree tracing across arXiv, Semantic Scholar, Google
 Scholar, PubMed, Crossref, OpenAlex, SSRN, Wikipedia and more, adapted from
 `sn-search-academic` (MIT). Its browser-crawler tier is optional and degrades
 to the official APIs and then to generic search.

Cross-skill hand-offs are documented in `references/protocol.md` section 2a:
local table files plus analysis route to `meld-da`; academic, scientific or
historical subjects route the scholarly layer through `meld-search-academic`.

en.headline: 3 own commits plus 6 automated; v0.3.0 shipped, issue #11 opened
en.summary: On 2026-10-06 the user made **3 own commits** in `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch`, plus 6 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. The own commits covered a release chore for `v0.3.1`, docs updates adding high-intent search terms to skill descriptions, and a CI fix making the academic degrade test dependency-aware and drawing gate 3. The `v0.3.0` release of `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` was published, turning the single research skill into a family of three cooperating skills (`meld-deepresearch`, `meld-da`, and a third) with a cleaner reading copy and three hard gates. The user opened issue #11 in `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch`, titled "[Feature]: 让 harness 可扩展（支持 OpenCode/Pi 等），并考虑以 MCP 形式对外暴露". In `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` issue #458, `goworm` replied and then closed the issue, noting the skills install path fix landed in 1.0.140. No pull requests, reviews, or discussions were recorded. `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` gained 1 star.

releaseNotes.summary: v0.3.0 turns the single research skill into a family of three cooperating skills: the core `meld-deepresearch` evidence/citation loop, an optional `meld-da` Excel/spreadsheet data-analysis workflow adapted from SenseNova-Skills' `sn-da-excel-workflow`, and a third skill. It also delivers a cleaner reading copy and three hard gates, as the full diff from v0.2.0.
